k-trader.title: Rudolph $RUDY meme coin in a Christmas film
k-trader.sourceSays: A post says the Christmas film "Christmas at the Kringles" has a futures trader put $500 on a reindeer memecoin called Rudolph ($RUDY); other posts describe the coin's reindeer branding.
k-trader.reason: A Nov 20 post cites a film scene featuring a Rudolph $RUDY memecoin, released weeks before the pool opened; the other two 'The Trader' coins have no posts and no story behind them.
